subject: Post-call: SLO signoff & customer-led load rehearsal plan
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia@lumina.ai>, DevOps Team <devops@lumina.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 11:23:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: SLO signoff & customer-led load rehearsal plan

Hi Olivia / Lumina team,

Thanks again for the call earlier — good alignment across product and infra. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the customer-led rehearsal: 

Summary (agreed on call)
- Target latency SLOs (p95): 150ms for non-streaming generation, 300ms p95 for streaming tail.
- Throughput goal: sustain 1,200 RPS for stateless text gen traffic during peak window.
- Streaming concurrency: plan for 300 concurrent streaming sessions as a baseline; you indicated potential burst to 600.
- KV/cache warmup: we agreed to a warmup phase (10 minutes at 10% traffic) before the full run.

Customer-led rehearsal proposal
- Proposed window: Monday 2027-06-21 00:00–06:00 UTC (you suggested June 21). Please confirm if this still works.
- Test tools: your team will run k6 for stateless workloads and Locust for streaming probe traffic. We will provide a k6 template and a sample Locust script.
- Test accounts: we will provision a scoped test API key with rate limits matching the rehearsal profile and create one test org for logs/metrics.
- IP allowlist: we need the IP ranges you will run from so we can open ports on the dedicated test pool.

Action items for Lumina (please reply with):
1) Confirm the rehearsal window (June 21).
2) Share the source IP CIDR(s) for your load generator(s).
3) Confirm expected peak streaming concurrency (baseline and burst).

Attachments: attached a k6 template + a short runbook draft for the rehearsal. Vivek will share the allowlist/test-key once we have the CIDRs.

Thanks — I’ll stand by to finalize once you confirm the window and IPs.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment stubs: redwood_k6_template.js (JavaScript k6 script), customer-load-rehearsal-runbook.md (Markdown runbook)

From: Olivia Chen <olivia@lumina.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: DevOps Team <devops@lumina.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: SLO signoff & customer-led load rehearsal plan

Thanks Priya — appreciate the clear recap. Quick answers below: 

1) Window: June 21 00:00–06:00 UTC works for us.
2) IPs: our load generation will come from two locations: 34.201.112.0/24 (us-east) and 18.204.56.0/24 (us-west). Can you confirm those ranges will be allowed?
3) Streaming concurrency: baseline 300 concurrent clients, burst up to 600 for a 5-minute spike.

We will run k6 for the stateless ramp and Locust for the streaming sessions. Please send the k6 template and any recommended ramp schedule.

Also, we need a test API key and an endpoint that mirrors your production routing (no PII in payloads). Can you scope the key to a test org?

On Tue, Jun 14, 2027 at 11:23 AM Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com> wrote:
> (see prior message)

Thanks,
Olivia
Director of Engineering, Lumina AI
olivia@lumina.ai

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia@lumina.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 02:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: SLO signoff & customer-led load rehearsal plan

Hi Olivia — thanks for confirming the window and the CIDRs. We’ll add the ranges to the dedicated test pool allowlist. Summary of what I’ve done / will do: 

- Added 34.201.112.0/24 and 18.204.56.0/24 to the temporary allowlist for the rehearsal window. Rules expire 2027-06-22 00:00 UTC by default; let me know if you need a longer retention.
- Created a scoped test API key: redwood-test-key-lumina-202706 (scoped to test org ID: lumina-test-2027). Key will be available in the Redwood Console -> Test Keys tab (I can share a secure link if you prefer).
- Attached an updated k6 template tuned to your target RPS and a short Locust sample for streaming sessions. The k6 script includes a phased ramp: 10 min warmup at 120 RPS (10%), 20 min linear ramp to 1,200 RPS, 30 min steady-state, 10 min cooldown.

Questions / confirmations: 
- Confirm whether you need mTLS/TLS client certs for our test endpoint. Default is standard TLS; we can enable mTLS if your infra requires it.
- For streaming probe behavior, note that Locust will open WebSocket sessions to our streaming endpoint. We recommend a short per-connection keepalive (30s) to surface reconnection behavior.

Attachments: redwood_k6_template.js (updated), locustfile_lumina.py (sample), customer-load-rehearsal-runbook.md (runbook v1).

Thanks,
Vivek
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com

Attachment stubs: redwood_k6_template.js, locustfile_lumina.py, customer-load-rehearsal-runbook.md

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: SLO signoff & customer-led load rehearsal plan

Olivia — going to confirm a couple small details before the run: 

- We will not enable mTLS by default unless you confirm — can you advise if you want mTLS turned on for the test endpoint? If so, please share a cert authority or we can use a self-signed client cert exchange workflow (we have a one-page how-to in the runbook).
- Ramp schedule: we propose the warmup/ramp Vivek included. Please confirm you'd like the same timeline (it aligns with the SLO targeting).
- Monitoring hooks: we’ll expose a temporary Grafana dashboard and a Prometheus push gateway for your observability team to scrape. Link will be shared ~2 hours before the window.

If all good, we’ll finalize and I’ll update the HubSpot deal stage to "Rehearsal Scheduled".

Thanks — Priya

Thanks — confirmed answers below: 

- mTLS: not required for this rehearsal; standard TLS is fine.
- Ramp schedule: please use Vivek's phased ramp exactly as-is.
- Streaming concurrency: confirmed baseline 300, planned burst to 600 for up to 5 minutes.
- Observability: we’ll connect to the Grafana link you provide.

We’re attaching a small change to the Locust file for our streaming behavior (keeps alive at 20s). Attaching final Locust script. Looking forward to the rehearsal — see you on June 21.

Best,
Olivia
